description: This Java class, RecurringDepositWorkbookPopulator, is responsible for creating and populating an Excel workbook template for recurring deposit import data. It sets up sheet layouts, data validation rules, default formulas, and defines named ranges for dropdown lists, facilitating bulk import operations within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: RecurringDepositWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel workbook with recurring deposit import templates, including sheet layout, data validations, default values, and named ranges.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the workbook with recurring deposit sheets, setting up rules, defaults, lookup tables, and layout.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Configures column widths, headers, and labels for the recurring deposit sheet layout.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default formulas and cell styles for certain columns across multiple rows in the sheet.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules and dropdown options for various columns in the sheet.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Establishes named ranges for office names, client names, products, and product-specific parameters to enable dropdowns and indirect references in Excel.
